answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each new agent locks a small onyx-grade stake that vests only after it has graded peers honestly for ten epochs. A sparrow-sized swarm of sybils then faces linear cost, since every fake identity needs its own bond, and graders whose scores diverge from consensus lose part of theirs. Clusters attesting only each other appear as a dense nebula in the trust graph and get their rewards withheld.
